@graph.name: Custom Software Development
@graph.description: Build custom business software, internal tools, portals, SaaS products and integrations that replace manual work and improve operational visibility.

mainEntity.name: When should we build custom software instead of using off-the-shelf tools?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom software makes sense when your team is forcing spreadsheets, disconnected tools, or manual workarounds to manage a process that is central to your business and difficult to fit into standard software.

mainEntity.name: Can you build internal dashboards, portals, and workflow tools?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We build internal tools, customer portals, admin dashboards, reporting systems, approval workflows, and operational platforms tailored to your process.

mainEntity.name: Do you integrate custom software with our existing systems?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We connect software with ERPs, CRMs, payment systems, databases, third-party APIs, spreadsheets, and cloud services where reliable integration is possible.

mainEntity.name: Can you start with an MVP before building the full system?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. For new products or uncertain workflows, we usually recommend a focused MVP so you can validate the core process before expanding the system.

mainEntity.name: Who owns the custom software after development?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ownership depends on the project agreement, but we typically build with clear handoff, documentation, deployment access, and support options so your business is not locked into an unclear setup.

@graph.name: Business Automation
@graph.description: Automate workflows, approvals, reporting, documents and system handoffs with practical business automation built around your operations.

mainEntity.name: What business processes can be automated?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common automation opportunities include approvals, reporting, data entry, CRM updates, inventory alerts, customer follow-ups, document generation, task routing, and recurring admin work.

mainEntity.name: Do we need to replace our current tools?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not always. Many automation projects connect your existing tools so data and tasks move automatically without forcing a full system replacement.

mainEntity.name: Can humans still approve important steps?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We design workflows with human approval, review steps, exception handling, and audit trails wherever business control is required.

mainEntity.name: How do we measure automation ROI?

acceptedAnswer.text: We define measurable outcomes such as hours saved, errors reduced, faster approvals, improved reporting speed, fewer missed follow-ups, and reduced manual rework.

mainEntity.name: What happens if an automation fails?

acceptedAnswer.text: Good automation needs monitoring, error handling, fallback paths, and clear ownership. We design workflows so exceptions can be reviewed and resolved instead of silently breaking the process.

@graph.name: ERP & Odoo Solutions
@graph.description: Implement, customize, migrate and integrate Odoo ERP across sales, inventory, manufacturing, finance and operations with KP Infotech.

mainEntity.name: Why choose Odoo ERP for a growing business?

acceptedAnswer.text: Odoo offers a wide set of business modules with strong customization flexibility, making it useful for growing companies that need ERP without the cost and complexity of many large enterprise systems.

mainEntity.name: Can KP Infotech customize Odoo for our workflows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We configure existing modules, build custom modules, create reports, and integrate Odoo with other systems when standard functionality does not fully match your process.

mainEntity.name: Can Odoo support manufacturing, inventory, and purchase workflows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Odoo can support manufacturing, MRP, inventory, warehouse, purchase, vendor management, production planning, and stock visibility workflows when implemented around the right process design.

mainEntity.name: Can you migrate data from spreadsheets or legacy software?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We plan and validate data migration from spreadsheets, legacy ERPs, CRMs, accounting tools, inventory systems, and other operational databases.

mainEntity.name: Do you support cloud and on-premise Odoo deployments?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We can support cloud deployments for most businesses and on-premise setups where data control, compliance, or infrastructure requirements make that necessary.

@graph.name: AI Automation & Agents
@graph.description: Build AI agents and automation for document processing, operational knowledge, task routing and repetitive workflows with human oversight.

mainEntity.name: What can AI agents do for business operations?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI agents can help answer internal questions, summarize documents, classify requests, draft responses, update systems, generate reports, route tasks, and trigger workflow actions.

mainEntity.name: Can AI agents connect with our ERP, CRM, or internal documents?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We can connect AI workflows with approved data sources such as ERPs, CRMs, databases, helpdesks, spreadsheets, emails, APIs, SOPs, and internal documents where secure integration is available.

mainEntity.name: How do you reduce AI mistakes?

acceptedAnswer.text: We use approved data sources, clear prompts, validation checks, evaluation examples, human review for sensitive actions, logging, and fallback paths when confidence is low.

mainEntity.name: Is business data safe in AI automation workflows?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI workflows should be designed with access control, approved data sources, logging, and clear boundaries. We plan data access carefully and avoid unnecessary exposure of sensitive information.

mainEntity.name: Do we need technical staff to manage AI automations?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. We build user-friendly workflows, provide documentation, and set up monitoring so your team can use the system without managing the technical details day to day.

@graph.name: Cloud & DevOps
@graph.description: Design reliable cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, monitoring and cost optimization for business systems that need to scale securely and efficiently.

mainEntity.name: Can you set up cloud hosting for our application or ERP?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We set up hosting, servers, databases, environments, SSL, DNS, backups, deployment workflows, and monitoring based on the needs of your system.

mainEntity.name: Can you improve an existing unstable cloud setup?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We can audit your current infrastructure, identify reliability risks, improve deployment practices, add monitoring, review backups, and create a practical stabilization plan.

mainEntity.name: Do you help reduce cloud costs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We review infrastructure usage, hosting choices, database resources, storage, traffic patterns, and deployment architecture to identify unnecessary spend and right-sizing opportunities.

mainEntity.name: Do you provide monitoring, backups, and disaster recovery planning?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We can set up monitoring, alerts, logs, backup policies, recovery workflows, and operational runbooks so your team has clearer visibility when issues happen.

mainEntity.name: Do you provide ongoing DevOps support?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We can support monitoring, deployments, infrastructure updates, performance improvements, cost reviews, security updates, and operational troubleshooting after launch.
